rows.behavior: The kmctl-auditor agent's tools are exactly Read, Grep and Glob, so the audit cannot write (I2).
rows.fails_when: plugin/agents/kmctl-auditor.md lists any tool other than Read, Grep and Glob, or lists no tools (which would inherit all)

rows.behavior: A findings sample the agent produced in a real run matches the defined shape.
rows.fails_when: plugin/skills/audit/evals/sample-findings.json is not a JSON list of objects with concept, path, review (architecture|decision|practice), verdict (holds|drifted|unsure), summary and evidence (list of path:line strings)

rows.behavior: The audit skill gets the due list from kmctl review due --json, keeps only architecture, decision and practice concepts, batches them, and hands them to kmctl-auditor.
rows.fails_when: plugin/skills/audit/SKILL.md does not name kmctl review due --json, the three in-scope sections, batching, and the kmctl-auditor agent

rows.behavior: The three review skills exist and the agent follows them.
rows.fails_when: any of plugin/skills/architecture-review, decision-log-review or practices-review has no SKILL.md, or the agent's prompt does not name all three

rows.behavior: The skills and agent were made with skill-creator, tried on this repository and on loop-harness at /home/vscode/workspace, and results.md counts real and false drift from the loop-harness run.
rows.fails_when: no test prompts or results are kept beside the audit skill, the loop-harness run is missing, or real and false drift are not counted
